# H2.6a — external single-file source maps: architecture and design packet

Status: **slice-opening design packet** for the H2.6a schedule row
([post-H1 schedule §4.5](../post-h1-completion-slices.md#45-maps-declarations-outputconfig-and-broad-qualification)):
source-map generator/recorder, original/synthetic/source-switch ranges,
external single-file `.js.map`, callback metadata, and path planning.
This packet authorizes **no production edit**. It freezes the pinned
upstream owner map, the current-Rust local-gap matrix, the
architecture-row dispositions, the H2.6a/H2.6b boundary, the
implementation ladder, and the oracle witness artifact that every
ladder packet consumes. Each production packet in the ladder passes the
[mandatory design gate](../post-h1-completion-slices.md#11-mandatory-implementation-ready-design-gate)
in its own packet document before its first edit.

For semantics, vendored TypeScript 6.0.3 owns every fact; the current
code and tests plus the freshly revalidated rows of
[the current emitter architecture](../emitter-architecture.md) own Rust
structure. `EA-GAP-MAPS-DECLS` states the standing rule for this slice:
the dormant recorder seams are deliberate but are **not** evidence — this
packet re-derives the recording model from the pinned upstream and
replaces the seams that do not carry it.

## 1. Identity, purpose, and boundary

- **Slice ID / kind:** `h2-6a`, kind `inventory` (design + frozen
  witness evidence; zero crate bytes change in this packet).
- **Purpose:** (1) pin the complete tsc 6.0.3 source-map owner surface
  (§4, appendix §14); (2) freeze the current-Rust local-gap matrix
  (§6); (3) disposition every architecture row (§7); (4) fix the exact
  H2.6a/H2.6b/H2.7e boundary (§5); (5) ratify the implementation
  ladder m-1..m-3 + ca-1..ca-2 (§8); and (6) freeze the W-H2.6A oracle
  witness artifact (§9) whose bytes are the entire expectation for the
  ladder's fixture gates.
- **Non-goals:** `inlineSourceMap`, `inlineSources`, `sourceRoot`,
  `mapRoot`, source-map URL placement variants, multi-source/transformed
  cross-file ranges, and map sink-failure behavior (all H2.6b);
  `declarationMap`/`.d.ts.map` (H2.7e); bundle/`outFile` maps (H2.7d,
  `outFile` is emit-refused today); `names`/`nameIndex` population (the
  6.0.3 printer never records names — §4.3); `appendSourceMap`,
  `decodeMappings`, and `addName` activation (dead code in the vendored
  `_tsc.js` build — §4.2); any change to hosted CI topology.
- **Prerequisites:** H2.0b (closed 2026-08-08) and the H1 printer hook
  lineage; all of H2.1a..H2.5h are landed and active
  (`ratchets/h2-5g-profile.v1.json` `transition` block:
  `next_slice: "H2.6a"`, `next_runtime_activation_slice: "H2.6a"`).
- **Trusted base:** `752803c74d24acb33b5675f767e8c7b4fda50d50` (the
  CA-4 merge, current `main`).
- **Activation state:** before — `E-MAPS` dormant,
  `DisabledSourceMapRecorder` hardcoded at the single production print
  call, `sourceMap`/`inlineSourceMap`/`inlineSources` and
  `sourceRoot`/`mapRoot` emit-refused
  (`crates/emitter/src/execute.rs:111-113,145-146`), the H2.6a activity
  counter reserved-zero. After this packet — unchanged (witnesses +
  design only). After the ladder — external single-file `.js.map` exact
  under the frozen witnesses and the ca-1 corpus band, `sourceMap`
  admitted, all other map options still typed-refused with H2.6b/H2.7e
  owners.
- **Next owner:** `h2-6a-m-1` (generator foundation packet).

## 4. Pinned upstream map

The complete span+hash table is appendix §14 (75 rows, hashes =
`sed -n 'A,Bp' vendor/typescript-6.0.3/lib/_tsc.js | shasum -a 256`).
The subsystem separates into five semantic groups. Every statement
below was read from the vendored bytes at the trusted base.

### 4.1 Generator state machine (`_tsc.js:92364-92732`)

`createSourceMapGenerator(host, file, sourceRoot, sourcesDirectoryPath,
generatorOptions)` closes over: `rawSources`/`sources`/
`sourceToSourceIndexMap` (dedup by RELATIVIZED path), optional
`sourcesContent`, `names` + lazy `nameToNameIndexMap`,
`mappingCharCodes` buffer + accumulated `mappings` string, the six
`last*` fields + `hasLast`, and the six `pending*` fields +
`hasPending`/`hasPendingSource`/`hasPendingName`.

- `addSource` (92401-92420): relativizes via
  `getRelativePathToDirectoryOrUrl(sourcesDirectoryPath, fileName,
  host.getCurrentDirectory(), host.getCanonicalFileName,
  /*isAbsolutePathAnUrl*/ true)`; dedupes on the relativized key;
  pushes the RAW `fileName` into `rawSources` in parallel.
- `addMapping` (92450-92476): commits the pending mapping only on a
  new generated position (`isNewGeneratedPosition`) or a backtracking
  source position (`isBacktrackingSourcePosition`, same sourceIndex
  with source line/char going backwards); then overwrites pending
  fields. Source fields are set only when all three of
  sourceIndex/sourceLine/sourceCharacter are present; nameIndex only
  on top of a present source.
- `shouldCommitMapping` (92524-92526): raw six-way inequality against
  `last*` — consecutive identical mappings collapse.
- `commitPendingMapping` (92533-92566): per line advance emits `;` and
  resets lastGeneratedCharacter to 0; same-line successors separated
  by `,` only when `hasLast`; VLQ field order = generatedCharacter
  delta, then (if source) sourceIndex/sourceLine/sourceCharacter
  deltas, then (if name) nameIndex delta.
- `appendBase64VLQ` (92586-92600): sign bit in the LSB, 5-bit digits,
  continuation bit 32, char codes via `base64FormatEncode`
  (92727-92729).
- `toJSON` (92573-92585): commits + flushes, then returns the object
  in EXACTLY this key order: `version: 3`, `file`, `sourceRoot`,
  `sources`, `names`, `mappings`, `sourcesContent` —
  `sourcesContent` stays `undefined` unless `setSourceContent` ran
  (only under `inlineSources`, H2.6b), so `JSON.stringify` DROPS the
  key. `toString` (92399) = `JSON.stringify(toJSON())`, no replacer,
  no indent.
- Buffer flush: `appendMappingCharCode` flushes at ≥1024 buffered
  codes; a Rust port that appends chars directly is byte-equivalent
  (the buffer is a JS `String.fromCharCode` batching detail with no
  observable boundary).

### 4.2 Dead code in this build (fail-closed evidence)

`appendSourceMap` (92477-92523), `decodeMappings` (92605-92726), and
`addName` (92432-92443, reachable only from `appendSourceMap`) have
ZERO call sites in `_tsc.js` outside the generator's own returned
object — they are the input-source-map/bundler lane, tree-shaken dead
in the tsc-only bundle. `getLineInfo`, `tryGetSourceMappingURL`,
`isRawSourceMap`, `tryParseRawSourceMap`, `sameMapping`,
`isSourceMapping`, and `createDocumentPositionMapper` do not exist in
`_tsc.js` at all (services-only, present in `typescript.js`). The
three module-level `sourceMapCommentRegExp*` constants (92602-92604)
have a single `_tsc.js` consumer, `getSourceFileVersionAsHashFromText`
(build-info signature hashing — BLD1 territory). The ladder therefore
ports NONE of these; each gets a typed-deferred disposition with owner
(input maps → H2.6b if its packet proves reachability, else BLD1/L3;
regexes → BLD1.2).

### 4.3 Recording sites inside the printer (`createPrinter`, `_tsc.js:116912`)

State (116951-116956): `sourceMapsDisabled` (true until a writer AND
generator are set — `setWriter`, 117109-117116), `sourceMapGenerator`,
`sourceMapSource`, `sourceMapSourceIndex`, and the
`mostRecentlyAddedSourceMapSource[Index]` memo. `setSourceFile`
(117101-117108) calls `setSourceMapSource(sourceFile)` — the file is
registered in `sources` at print start even if zero mappings follow.
`setSourceMapSource` (121352-121370) memoizes, skips JSON sources, and
calls `addSource` (plus `setSourceContent` only under
`printerOptions.inlineSources`).

The recorded-mapping set is EXACTLY the union of:

1. **Every pipeline-emitted node.** `getPipelinePhase`
   (117185-117215) inserts phase 3 for every node with
   `shouldEmitSourceMaps(node)` = `!sourceMapsDisabled &&
   !isSourceFile(node) && !isInJsonFile(node)`. The phase order is
   Notification → Substitution → Comments → SourceMaps → Emit, so
   leading comments print BEFORE the leading map position and trailing
   comments print AFTER the trailing map position.
   `emitSourceMapsBeforeNode` (121283-121293): for non-
   `NotEmittedStatement` nodes without `NoLeadingSourceMap` and
   `sourceMapRange.pos >= 0`, records at
   `skipSourceTrivia(source, sourceMapRange.pos)` where source =
   `sourceMapRange.source || sourceMapSource` (the SOURCE-SWITCH
   lane, `emitSourcePos` 121322-121332 saving/restoring the current
   source); then `NoNestedSourceMaps` sets `sourceMapsDisabled = true`
   for the subtree. `emitSourceMapsAfterNode` (121294-121303) mirrors:
   re-enable on `NoNestedSourceMaps`, then record `sourceMapRange.end`
   (NO trivia skip) unless `NoTrailingSourceMap`.
   `emitPos` (121307-121321) drops synthesized positions
   (`positionIsSynthesized`, 18811) and JSON sources, converts with
   `getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(sourceMapSource, pos)`, and calls
   `addMapping(writer.getLine(), writer.getColumn(),
   sourceMapSourceIndex, line, character, /*nameIndex*/ undefined)` —
   **names are NEVER recorded by the 6.0.3 printer**.
2. **Every `writeToken`-routed token.** `writeToken` (120210-120212)
   dispatches to `emitTokenWithSourceMap` (121333-121351) whenever
   maps are enabled: leading position at
   `skipSourceTrivia(source, range ? range.pos : tokenPos)` unless
   `NoTokenLeadingSourceMaps`; the token range may be overridden by
   `emitNode.tokenSourceMapRanges[token]` including a foreign
   `range.source`; trailing position at the callback-returned pos (or
   `range.end`) unless `NoTokenTrailingSourceMaps`. JSON-file context
   nodes bypass recording entirely. Callers of `writeToken` are the
   route-level `emitTokenWithComment` sites plus direct calls — in the
   Rust printer these correspond to the existing typed
   `TokenEmission`/token-cursor writes (the comment-parity machinery
   already enumerates them).
3. **Every written comment.** All five comment writers record
   `emitPos(commentPos)` / `emitPos(commentEnd)` around the comment
   text: `emitLeadingComment` (121151-121165), `emitTrailingComment`
   (121179-121190), `emitTrailingCommentOfPositionNoNewline`
   (121199-121207), `emitTrailingCommentOfPosition` (121208-121218),
   and detached-range `emitComment` (121268-121273). Under
   `removeComments` the writers do not run, so their mappings vanish
   with the bytes.

Generated positions come from the shared `createTextWriter`
(16365-16461): EVERY text-appending method (`write`, `rawWrite`,
`writeLiteral`, `writeComment`, and all classified aliases including
`writeStringLiteral`) routes through `updateLineCountAndPosFor`, so
line/column tracking is unconditional in 6.0.3. `getColumn` (16444) =
`lineStart ? indent * getIndentSize() : output.length - linePos`
(pending-indent column at line start). The `emitLiteral` branch
(117775-117779: maps choose `writeLiteral` over `writeStringLiteral`
for string/template literals) is observationally inert in this build —
both aliases are `write` — and is pinned here so nobody re-derives a
phantom semantic from it.

### 4.4 Orchestration, URL, callback metadata, write order

`emitFiles` (116530): `sourceMapDataList` allocated iff
`sourceMap || inlineSourceMap || declarationMap-enabled` (116532) and
surfaced as `emitResult.sourceMaps` (116553). Per JS unit,
`emitJsFileOrBundle` (116587-116639) builds printer options carrying
`sourceMap`/`inlineSourceMap`/`inlineSources` and calls
`printSourceFileOrBundle` (116744-116804):

1. gate `shouldEmitSourceMaps(mapOptions, sourceFileOrBundle)`
   (116805-116807): `(sourceMap || inlineSourceMap)` AND NOT a
   `.json` source file;
2. `createSourceMapGenerator(host,
   getBaseFileName(normalizeSlashes(jsFilePath)),
   getSourceRoot(mapOptions), getSourceMapDirectory(...), mapOptions)`
   — `file` = js basename only; `sourceRoot` (116808-116811) =
   `""` when the option is absent (the H2.6a case) and the KEY IS
   STILL EMITTED as `"sourceRoot":""`; `sourcesDirectoryPath`
   (116812-116825) with neither `sourceRoot` nor `mapRoot` =
   `getDirectoryPath(normalizePath(jsFilePath))` — the JS OUTPUT
   directory;
3. print the file (writer shared across units, reset by
   `printer.writeFile` → `reset()`);
4. push `{ inputSourceFileNames: sourceMapGenerator.getSources()
   (RAW absolute-ish file names), sourceMap: toJSON() }` onto
   `sourceMapDataList`;
5. `getSourceMappingURL` (116826-116857): H2.6a lane (no inline, no
   mapRoot) = `encodeURI(getBaseFileName(normalizeSlashes(
   sourceMapFilePath)))`;
6. append the URL comment: if the writer is mid-line, `rawWrite`
   one `newLine`; `sourceMapUrlPos = writer.getTextPos()` (UTF-16
   offset where `//#` begins); `writer.writeComment("//# sourceMappingURL=" + url)`
   with NO trailing newline — a mapped file ends without a final
   newline, whereas the mapless arm runs `writer.writeLine()`
   (116796-116798);
7. **write the map FIRST**: `writeFile(host, emitterDiagnostics,
   sourceMapFilePath, sourceMapGenerator.toString(),
   /*writeByteOrderMark*/ false, sourceFiles)` — no `data` argument
   (116784-116795);
8. **write the JS second** with
   `data = { sourceMapUrlPos, diagnostics: transform.diagnostics }`
   and `!!compilerOptions.emitBOM` (116799-116801);
9. `emittedFiles` (under `listEmittedFiles`) lists js THEN map
   (116633-116638) — the LIST order is the reverse of the WRITE
   order, per unit.

Path planning: `getSourceMapFilePath` (116388-116390) =
`options.sourceMap && !options.inlineSourceMap ? jsFilePath + ".map" :
undefined`; `getOutputPathsFor` (116373-116387) additionally forces
`undefined` for JSON source files. Collision checks
(`verifyCompilerOptions`, 125018-125050) call `verifyEmitFilePath`
for `jsFilePath` and `declarationFilePath` ONLY — **map paths are
never collision-blocked upstream**, and `isEmitBlocked` consults the
JS path alone (116591). The current Rust preflight (js+dts only,
`plan.rs:414-417`) is therefore already upstream-exact; the earlier
draft assumption that map paths need collision coverage is FALSIFIED
by the pinned bytes.

`getRelativePathToDirectoryOrUrl` (5734-5747) +
`getPathComponentsRelativeTo` (5694-5713): resolve both paths against
`currentDirectory`, compare components with the CANONICAL file name
except component 0 which always compares case-insensitively; on zero
shared components return the absolute `to` components with a
`file://`/`file:///` prefix (the isAbsolutePathAnUrl arm); otherwise
`..` climbs plus the remainder. `sources[]` entries are NOT
`encodeURI`-escaped (only the URL comment is).

### 4.5 Options verification (program-side, already conformance-covered)

`verifyCompilerOptions`: `inlineSourceMap` conflicts (124770-124777,
TS5053 vs `sourceMap`/`mapRoot`); `inlineSources`/`sourceRoot` require
a map option (124855-124861, TS5051); `mapRoot` requires
`sourceMap || declarationMap` (124863-124865, TS5069). These
diagnostics are validated by the T0=100% conformance gate today and
are NOT re-implemented by this slice; the witness set asserts the
codes as observed context only.

## 5. The H2.6a boundary and adjacent-ratchet invariance

| Behavior | H2.6a | Owner if not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sourceMap=true`, external `<js>.map`, per-file | YES | — |
| `sourceRoot`/`mapRoot`/`inlineSourceMap`/`inlineSources` (any value) | typed emit-refusal retained | H2.6b |
| sources relativization incl. `file://` cross-root arm | YES (mechanical part of `addSource`) | — |
| `sourcesContent` | never emitted (requires `inlineSources`) | H2.6b |
| map sink-failure/partial-output observation | write-loop behavior exists mechanically; not claimed/witnessed | H2.6b |
| multi-source `sourceMapRange.source` switches | seam + adjacent control only (single-file inputs cannot reach a foreign source today) | H2.6b |
| `declarationMap` | refused | H2.7e |
| bundle (`outFile`) maps | `outFile` refused | H2.7d/H2.8a |
| `names`/`nameIndex` | structurally supported by the generator port, never fed (upstream never feeds it) | — (upstream parity) |
| input source maps (`appendSourceMap` lane) | not ported (dead upstream) | H2.6b re-derives if reachable |

**Divergence-ratchet invariance:** all 93
`h2-5h-known-divergences` rows keep their exact facets: the 5h band
was dependency-closed WITHOUT H2.6a, so no admitted 5h row sets
`sourceMap` (a `sourceMap` row would carry `rejected-option:sourceMap`
in the H2.0a blocker table and list H2.6a); the 8 `h2-5h-project-r1`
`emit_refused` rows carry `mapRoot`/`sourceRoot`/`rootDir`, all of
which STAY refused. ca-2 re-verifies by running `run_h2_5h` unchanged.

## 7. Architecture-row dispositions (ladder-level)

Every row of the current architecture map, exactly once. This packet
changes no production code, so every disposition below states the
LADDER's impact; each production packet re-validates its own rows
through its own design gate (the h2-5h-a amendment discipline).

- **activate:** `E-MAPS` (the slice target; hook-event model replaced
  per G2); `E-OUTPUT-FUTURE` (JavaScriptMap arm only).

## 8. Implementation ladder

Per-packet design gates; every packet before m-3 is corpus-inert
(the full-corpus ratchet stays byte-identical); each packet's envelope
names its own allowed/forbidden paths.

1. **`h2-6a-m-1` — generator foundation (kind `foundation`).** The
   source-map generator as a new `crates/emitter/src/source_map.rs`
   module: the closure state machine as an owned struct (twelve
   scalar fields + two flags-groups exactly as §4.1; no
   `Option`-collapse of the `has*` flags), `add_source`/
   `set_source_content` (H2.6b-consumed, landed dormant with the
   struct)/`add_mapping`/`to_json_string`; the VLQ/base64 encoders;
   the relativization function (G7) as a pure path helper with the
   component-0 case-insensitivity and `file://` arms; ledger-pinned
   (`tsc-port`/`tsc-hash`/`tsc-span` comment triple) to the §14 rows.
   Dead-upstream members (§4.2) are NOT ported; the struct's public
   surface documents their absence with the owner table. Focused unit
   contracts: VLQ vectors (sign/continuation/multi-digit), dedupe
   state machine (new-position/backtracking/identical-collapse), line
   advance/reset, JSON key order + sourcesContent omission, and
   generator-level replays of the W-H2.6A `map_json` fields (feed the
   witnessed mapping sequences, byte-compare `toString`). Zero
   integration into execute/printer.
2. **`h2-6a-m-2` — recording model (kind `foundation`).** Replaces the
   dormant hook seam with the upstream recording model (§4.3): a
   per-print recording context owning `sourceMapSource`/index memo +
   `sourceMapsDisabled` nesting, fed by (a) a node-boundary phase at
   the pipeline chokepoint for every emitted node (leading skip-trivia
   / trailing raw-end, EmitFlags gates, `NotEmittedStatement` skip,
   source-switch save/restore), (b) the existing typed token-write
   machinery (`TokenEmission` sites ↔ upstream `writeToken` routes,
   with `token_source_map_ranges` overrides), (c) the comment writers,
   and (d) the identity-stream answer for G3 chosen by that packet's
   own pinned analysis with JS-byte invariance proven by the frozen
   corpus ratchet. Production keeps `DisabledSourceMapRecorder`; the
   packet's fixture suite drives a live test recorder through
   `Printer::print` and byte-compares generator output against the
   W-H2.6A `map_json`/`mappings` fields per family. Corpus-inert.
3. **`h2-6a-m-3` — runtime flip (kind `runtime`).** Lift ONLY the
   `sourceMap` refusal (G11); JSON-arm planning fix (G6); live
   recorder + generator wiring in `emit_files_with_activity`; map
   artifact construction in upstream write order + `emittedFiles` list
   order (G8); URL comment + `sourceMapUrlPos` (G9);
   `EmitOutcome.source_maps` (G10); `h2_6a_profile()` admission +
   `observe_runtime_slice(H2_6a)` at the map-generation entry (G13);
   `l0-source-options` re-mint; the W-H2.6A witness fixture gate as
   the CS-6/B-5-analog: every parity-lane case byte-exact on js AND
   map AND write order AND metadata, every refusal-lane case
   typed-refused; the h1 ladder re-mint that any crate-byte change
   entails.
4. **`h2-6a-ca-1` — band observation (kind `evidence`, mjs-only).**
   The dependency-closed H2.6a corpus band from
   `h2-candidate-dispositions` (rows listing `H2.6a` whose other
   required slices are all landed; measured at packet time from the
   630-row superset: compiler 192 / conformance 32 / project 404 /
   transpile 2 before closure filtering), double-observed
   fresh-process with exact writes (js+map bytes), diagnostics,
   `emitResult.sourceMaps`, per-write callback `data`, and write
   order; frozen as `ratchets/h2-6a-qualification.v1.json` +
   schema + registry row + check receipt, on the CA-1/CA-3 pattern
   (project rows through the CA-3 mount/option-floor discipline).
5. **`h2-6a-ca-2` — acceptance wiring + landing (kind `runtime`).**
   `run_h2_6a` on the `run_h2_5h` clone base (same worker env, same
   deferred COUNT-ONLY rule, facet-exact divergence manifest ONLY if
   the first sweep proves diverging rows — every entry named-owner,
   shrink-only); `fn acceptance` append + policy pin refresh
   (same-commit); local `h2-6a-oracle` freshness phase; the
   transition landing: `h2-5g-profile.mjs` transition block
   (+H2.6a active, inactive 14→13, `next_slice` per the schedule
   review at landing time, `h2_6a_*` count fields) + schema consts +
   `h2-5h-a-foundation.mjs` parent-profile pins in ONE commit;
   `h2-transition.mjs` chain-walk hash re-mint only; handoff close
   markers here and in the index.

## 9. W-H2.6A witness machine (frozen by this packet)

Generator `crates/oracle/h2-6a-witnesses.mjs`
(`--write|--check|--internal-observe-witness`), artifact
`ratchets/h2-6a-witnesses.v1.json`, contract
`.github/ci/contracts/h2-6a-witnesses.schema.json`, registered in the
`ARTIFACT_SCHEMA_CONTRACTS` table. Mechanics follow the frozen 5h
witness machines: virtual `/project` host over the vendored bundle,
every case observed twice in fresh pinned-TypeScript processes,
byte-exact capture, no hand-authored expected output anywhere. Beyond
the 5h serializer, every write records the callback's `data` argument
(`source_map_url_pos`, diagnostics presence) and every case records
`emit_result.source_maps` (`input_source_file_names` +
`JSON.stringify(sourceMap)`), `emitted_files` when listed, and the
write ORDER as the array order; the generator asserts per case that a
written `.js.map` byte-equals the `emit_result` map's stringification
(one `toJSON` authority).

Ten families, each with positive / adjacent-negative-control /
(composition|fault) roles; every case carries `rust_lane`:
`parity` (m-2/m-3 byte targets) or `refusal-control` (H2.6b-option
guards asserted typed-refused in Rust):

| Family | Exercises |
| --- | --- |
| `plain-program` | node-boundary recording, skip-trivia starts, writeToken keywords/braces; negative = same source without `sourceMap` (single write, no URL comment, no `sourceMaps` result) |
| `multiline-literals` | template/string literals across lines at es2015 and lowered at es5 (writer line tracking, G4) |
| `comment-interaction` | leading/trailing/detached comment mappings; both `removeComments` polarities |
| `transform-composition` | es5 class + captured-loop `for-of` + generator + destructuring + spread through the live H2.1-5h stack (synthetic nodes with original `sourceMapRange` provenance; `tokenSourceMapRanges` if the oracle output proves a producer) |
| `path-shapes` | `outDir` with nested sources (`..` climbs in `sources[]`), flat default (basename), percent-encodable file name (URL comment `encodeURI` vs raw `sources[]`) |
| `json-exclusion` | `resolveJsonModule` import with `outDir`: TS output mapped, JSON output NOT (G6/G15) |
| `newline-variants` | `newLine` CRLF vs LF: URL-append newline, identical `mappings` |
| `edge-shapes` | empty file, comments-only file, missing final newline, shebang (`sources` registration with zero mappings; URL append at line start) |
| `fault` | `noEmitOnError` + error + `sourceMap` (zero writes, `emitSkipped`), declared-only file emit shape |
| `boundary-controls` | `refusal-control` lane: `sourceMap`+`sourceRoot`, `sourceMap`+`mapRoot`, `inlineSourceMap` alone, `inlineSources`+`sourceMap` — oracle bytes frozen as the H2.6b inheritance, Rust asserted typed-refused until H2.6b |

Family/case counts, exact option floors, and the artifact fingerprint
are owned by the generator + schema (consts), not restated here. The
packet checker (§11) is the full re-observation backstop; the
per-gate registry validates schema subset + fingerprint only.

| generator closure state (six `last*`, six `pending*`, three `has*`, sources/names tables, `mappings`) | owned struct in `crates/emitter/src/source_map.rs`, exhaustive fields, no interior mutability | m-1 |

| map write (no BOM, no data) | `EmitArtifact::javascript_map` (verified shape) | m-3 |

| admission | `H2ActivityCanary::h2_6a_profile()` + `observe_runtime_slice(H2RuntimeSlice::H2_6a)` | m-3 |
